critique: The palette is closer to Smokey Fire now: orange-gold ember detail sits against charcoal smoke on black, and the t1-to-t4 change clearly shows active particle motion. But the structure remains a centered, nearly circular blast. At t4, sparks form a large evenly radial halo while the smoke expands symmetrically around a small brown-orange ring with a dark center. It does not yet present as a dense luminous flame body feeding an irregular, vertically rising smoke plume like the preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Reduce velocity variation so particles stop filling a broad, uniform radial explosion and remain concentrated in a flame/smoke source.
Further narrow the emitter direction spread to break the circular burst silhouette and establish a more coherent plume direction.
Increase upward acceleration so the smoke and glowing particles develop a visibly rising, asymmetric fire-plume motion instead of expanding evenly outward.
Increase source density to fill the dark center and create a more continuous luminous flame body rather than a thin ring of sprite particles.
